D3.recall95_rule: first empirical recall strictly above 0.95, as in official STU

definitions.observation: one sequence/frame/GT-instance observation, not an independent physical object
definitions.radius: median across valid anomaly queries of the maximum distance to their actual 31 other decoder neighbors, in meters
definitions.normal_fraction: normal-labeled edges / all 31 non-self edges, using full observed scan context including outside the metric range
definitions.frame_rank: mean P(anomaly score > same-frame valid normal score) + half ties; metric-record weighted within each instance
definitions.neighbor_rank: mean per-query win fraction against its actual normal neighbors, half ties; queries with no normal neighbor are excluded and counted
definitions.labels: raw 0 ignored, raw 2 anomaly, other raw classes normal; these observed quantities do not label physical height or occlusion
definitions.thresholds: reuse each checkpoint's already fitted full-official normal thresholds; no subgroup fitting

limitations: observational associations conditional on two fixed single-seed models and fitted thresholds; val19 is development data; no causal or across-seed inference

radius_median_m.rule: within-stratum > median versus <= median; identical values are never split; both sides receive the same stratum-size weights

normal_neighbor_fraction.rule: within-stratum > median versus <= median; identical values are never split; both sides receive the same stratum-size weights

primary.outcome_direction: positive means D3 worse: extra complete miss, D1 minus D3 point recall, or D1 minus D3 normal rank
primary.joint_model: both log2(radius) and normal fraction / 0.1, with a separate intercept for each distance/return-count stratum
primary.interval_scope: paired sequence-cluster bootstrap, refitting stratum means; conditional on these models, strata and fitted thresholds; no multiplicity correction or training-seed inference
